title: build:candidate leaves the root package.json rewrite behind when packing throws before the restore
description: Found by the independent adversarial review of QCLI-419 (finding F5, 2026-09-29, inferred by line-by-line read, not executed). scripts/build-candidate-bundle.mjs rewrites the root package.json in place (questPlatformPackages digests, then a version swap per launcher pack) and restores it at two success-path points: after the rc launcher packs and after the final launcher packs. If the first `npm pack` or packLauncher throws (pack failure, tarballName mismatch), neither restore runs and the tree is left mutated -- version "X-rc.N" with re-derived digests -- which is exactly the hazard the file has a comment about: a red-case tampered digest once reached dev inside another change. Pre-existing, not a regression from QCLI-419, and outside that task scope. Fix direction: try/finally (or an explicit restore in each throw path) around the rewrite, proven with a fixture whose pack fails (e.g. a poisoned npm invocation seam) red before and green after.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A pack failure during bundle assembly leaves the working-tree package.json byte-identical to its pre-run state, proven by a red-then-green fixture that forces the failure.

plan: Wrap the root package.json rewrite and both launcher packs in a try/finally in scripts/build-candidate-bundle.mjs so the original manifest is restored on the failure path as well as the success path, and drop the now-redundant trailing restore.

Add a red-then-green fixture to test/e2e/release/candidate-bundle.test.ts forcing the root pack to throw (member-check failure and tarball-name mismatch), asserting package.json is byte-identical to its pre-run state.
Run bun run check with the pinned bun 1.4.2.
Tracker-only commit before review: file one follow-up task for the adjacent unpinned peer reads and append a correction note to QCLI-396 naming it.
Read the head required contexts green, then review-assignment against the exact SHA, then opum-control task land job-1jtojo5.
finalSummary: QCLI-420: wrapped the root package.json mutation window in scripts/build-candidate-bundle.mjs in a try/finally, so the original manifest is restored on the failure path as well as the success path, and deleted the now-redundant trailing restore. originalRootPackage is read before the try; tarballs/final/digests/packages and rcRow/finalRow are declared before it; the digest write, the rm plus three mkdirs, the packLauncher definition and both packLauncher calls are inside the try; the finally restores unconditionally. No signature change, so no .d.mts change. Verified red-then-green on the pinned bun 1.4.2: with the fix reverted both new tests fail on the byte-identical assertion (the tree left mutated at version 9.9.9-rc.1 with re-derived digests); with the fix applied both pass and the file is 10 pass / 0 fail; bun run check exits 0 (1156 tests across 132 files). Evidence head b75867f53fc3d381f54f728ce1b82891496ae3ba. Both tests force a real npm failure inside the window: deleting the root bin/quest.cjs makes pack() throw on the missing member, and renaming the root package makes packLauncher throw on the tarball-name mismatch.
